payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each source station, delivery time = (candy_count-1)*n + min distance to a destination. For start station i, total time = max_j (dist(i,j) + time_j). Greedy pick of last delivery destination minimizes per-source time.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy exchange: for each station with candies, the train must do full loops except the last trip, so picking the closest destination as the last minimizes the total per-source time. Then overall time is max of (travel + source delivery). Fits greedy exchange argument pattern.
